notes: Owner: *"what I see is not time series for each driver/source. I see one value.. I'm not seeing a time series of pro formas out into the future nor the monte carlo functionality that I would expect at each layer."* Correct on both counts, and the spec now records the correction with the reason: the first cut carried elasticities as scalars, violating the layer principle — and the economics: sensitivities are regime-dependent (a deposit beta early-cycle is not its late-cycle self; the semis GDP beta depends on the inventory cycle). - Every elasticity is now a per-period SERIES on the pro forma
